I am a quantitative researcher interested in climate, heat stress, environmental data science, and systems modelling. I completed the Integrated BS–MS programme at IISER Pune, with research spanning high-resolution climate reanalysis, nonlinear heat-stress metrics, statistical trend analysis, network methods, and agent-based modelling. I am now particularly interested in quantitative and systems approaches to climate adaptation and mitigation planning.

My recent work asks a recurring question: **how much do the conclusions of environmental analysis depend on the way we define, aggregate, and operationalise the quantities we measure?**
